confirm.note: About 140 call sites. Every object comes from `localization.message`, `item_message` or `kill_message`, except `cave_say` with a string. `exchange` has a plain `{message, color}` branch (node/server_functions.js:4130-4136), but no caller passes a `phrase` that reaches it.
Every call site adds only `color`, or `color` and `confetti` (the giveaway lines), as extra fields.

senders.what: About 130 call sites send it to the socket of one character. Examples: failures without a response code, gold, XP, loot, purchases, tavern results.
`kill_monster`: the kill line goes to the killer, or with `party_emit` to the whole party.
`open_chest` in a party: loot lines with `party_emit`.
`enter` of a duel as a spectator: `instance_emit` to the duel instance.
The tavern closes: `instance_emit` to the tavern.
A giveaway ends: `xy_emit` near the merchant, with `confetti`.
Cave and generated-map messages: each cave player of the run.
`mreport` replies with a bare string: the distance to the point `x`, `y`.
`random_look` replies with a bare string and stops. The rest of the handler never runs.
